SourceProxy.name: SHYXSelectionPlaneClipper
SourceProxy.label: SHYX Selection Plane Clipper

Documentation.short_help: SHYX Selection Plane Clipper: Clip mesh with a plane from selected faces, lines, or points.

SourceProxy.Documentation: Port 0 input is the full surface; port 0 output is the clipped mesh. Port 1 is a vtkSelection (same convention as SHYX Selection Extrude and VESPA Region Fairing). Creating the filter copies the Input's active selection into the Selection widget. Copy Active Selection stores that view selection (from any pipeline node) in the Selection box as the source of truth for the initial plane. Faces (triangles, quads, polygons, strips) use the area-weighted centroid and average normal. Lines and points fit a PCA plane when they are not collinear; otherwise the normal comes from incident surface (or point) normals, with a last-resort perpendicular to a single line. Show Interactive Cut Plane displays the widget from InteractiveCutPacked when that is already set (including a loaded .pvsm after a manual drag); otherwise it computes a world-space plane from the copied selection. It does not clip and does not clear the view selection. Apply performs the clip. No separate Extract Selection filter is required. With Tip connectivity (default), clipping follows the same strategy as SHYX Vessel End Clipper (discards the small fragment near the selection). Invert Result keeps that small fragment instead and discards the large remainder. Optional Selection Cell Array Name selects cells on port 0 when no selection is provided. Fill Holes (default ON) closes small boundary loops after clipping. By default that is vtkFillHolesFilter ear-clip triangulation; enable Wheel Cap from Plane Center to fan triangles from the clip-plane origin to the opening (a wheel-shaped cap). Remaining holes that are not on the clip plane still use vtkFillHolesFilter. Hole size is automatic from the result bounds unless you set Fill Holes Maximum Size. Cell data from the clipped surface is restored after filling. New fill-hole triangles are stamped on the cell array named Fill Hole Stamp Array Name (default EndpointIndex). By default the marker is max(existing values)+1; enable Use Custom Marker Value to supply an explicit number instead. Other cell arrays copy tuple from cell 0.

InputProperty.name: Selection
InputProperty.label: Selection
InputProperty.Documentation: Copied vtkSelection (ParaView SelectionInput). Copy Active Selection from any pipeline node in the view; this copied selection is the source of truth for the initial plane. Faces, lines, or points all work. Show Interactive Cut Plane computes the plane from these ids on the dataset that was copied from. Apply clips the Input mesh with that plane.

StringVectorProperty.name: SelectionCellArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Selection Cell Array Name
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: If Selection is empty: name of a cell data array on Input. Cells are selected when value is greater than 0.5 (float) or non-zero (integer types), same as SHYX Selection Extrude.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: ClipOffset
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Clip Offset
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Shift the plane origin along the fitted normal from the selection centroid.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseTipConnectivity
IntVectorProperty.label: Tip Connectivity (Vessel End Clipper style)
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON (default), split the mesh by the plane and discard the smaller connected fragment near the selection centroid (keep the large remainder). Invert Result swaps that choice. When OFF, remove a single half-space controlled by Remove Positive Half-Space.

IntVectorProperty.name: InvertResult
IntVectorProperty.label: Invert Result
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Default OFF: keep the large remainder (Tip Connectivity discards the small piece near the selection). When ON: keep that small piece instead (cut away the large remainder). When Tip Connectivity is OFF, swaps which half-space is kept.

IntVectorProperty.name: RemovePositiveHalfSpace
IntVectorProperty.label: Remove Positive Half-Space
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: Only when Tip Connectivity is OFF: if ON, delete the side where the plane implicit function is positive; if OFF, delete the negative side.

IntVectorProperty.name: FillHoles
IntVectorProperty.label: Fill Holes
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON (default), close small open boundary loops after clipping. Use Wheel Cap from Plane Center for a fan from the clip-plane origin; otherwise vtkFillHolesFilter triangulates the hole. Turn OFF to keep the clip as an open surface.

IntVectorProperty.name: WheelCap
IntVectorProperty.label: Wheel Cap from Plane Center
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When Fill Holes is ON: insert the clip-plane origin as a hub and triangulate each clip opening as a wheel (one triangle per boundary edge). Openings that are not on the clip plane still use vtkFillHolesFilter. Default OFF.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: FillHolesMaximumSize
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Fill Holes Maximum Size
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Maximum boundary edge length considered for filling (vtkFillHolesFilter hole size). Zero (default) selects automatically from the clipped mesh bounding diagonal (about 35 percent).

IntVectorProperty.name: UseCustomFillHoleMarkerValue
IntVectorProperty.label: Use Custom Marker Value
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When OFF (default), new fill-hole triangles receive max(existing values)+1 automatically, or 1 when the stamp array does not yet exist. When ON, Fill Hole New Cell Marker Value is used instead.

DoubleVectorProperty.name: FillHoleNewCellDataMarkerValue
DoubleVectorProperty.label: Fill Hole New Cell Marker Value
DoubleVectorProperty.Documentation: Explicit marker written on each new fill-hole triangle when Use Custom Marker Value is ON.

StringVectorProperty.name: FillHoleStampCellArrayName
StringVectorProperty.label: Fill Hole Stamp Array Name
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Name of the cell array that marks new fill-hole triangles. If the array already exists before filling, it is reused and new triangles receive max(existing)+1 (or the custom marker when Use Custom Marker Value is ON). If the array does not exist, a new vtkDoubleArray is created (pre-fill cells = 0, new cells = 1 or custom marker). Empty string falls back to EndpointIndex.

IntVectorProperty.name: UseInteractiveCutPlanes
IntVectorProperty.label: Show Interactive Cut Plane
IntVectorProperty.Documentation: When ON, the yellow plane widget is shown. If InteractiveCutPacked is empty, the plane is computed from the copied Selection (Copy Active Selection first). If packed is already set (previous drag, Apply, or a loaded .pvsm), that saved plane is restored. This does not clip and does not clear the view selection. Turning it OFF only hides the widget. Apply clips using InteractiveCutPacked when present. Drag the plane afterwards if needed.

StringVectorProperty.name: InteractiveCutPacked
StringVectorProperty.Documentation: Persisted plane: six doubles (origin xyz, direction-handle xyz) for the implicit plane widget. Written when the plane is placed from Selection or dragged; restored from .pvsm.
